title: Ordinary total tensor contraction commutes with coefficient quotients
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite-dimensional extension E of Q_l, and a scheme X [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let B be the unrestricted completed integral coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Write F_n for ordinary scalar extension to the quotient B_n followed by restriction, applied degreewise, and tau_n for its specified quotient transition [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. Write T for ordinary total tensor of unbounded cochain complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. There exist chain maps b(P,Q,n): T(P,F_n Q) -> F_n T(P,Q), for all complexes P,Q and all n, satisfying in every bidegree (i,j), on every section over U, b(x tensor (s tensor y)) = s tensor (x tensor y). Here both tensor symbols denote the actual sheafification and total-summand maps, and s is a section of B_n. These maps satisfy T(P,tau_n(Q));b(P,Q,n) = b(P,Q,n+1);tau_n(T(P,Q)). No flatness, derived localization, tensor presentation or reduction presentation is assumed.

proof.text: Construct the balanced map x tensor (s tensor y) to s tensor (x tensor y), sheafify it, and take its sum over total-degree summands. Scalar degree is zero, so both signed total differentials agree; this defines the required chain maps on arbitrary complexes.

The defining quotient transition sends s tensor y to q(s) tensor y. Thus both composites send every generating homogeneous tensor to q(s) tensor (x tensor y). Tensor induction, sheafification, and coproduct extensionality prove the transition equation, including n=0.

theorem ordinaryTensorQuotient_contractions :
    let R := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X
    let F := fun n : ℕ ↦ (sfReductionRestricted l E X n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let T := totalTensor.{u, u} X R
    ∃ b : ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E X) ℤ) (n : ℕ),
        (T.obj P).obj ((F n).obj Q) ⟶ (F n).obj ((T.obj P).obj Q),
      (∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E X) ℤ) (n : ℕ)
          (i j : ℤ) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ)
          (s : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n).obj.obj U)
          (x : (P.X i).val.obj U) (y : (Q.X j).val.obj U),
        ((b P Q n).f (i + j)).val.app U
            (totalPair.{u, u} X R P ((F n).obj Q) i j U x
              (sfReductionTensor l E X n (Q.X j) U s y)) =
          sfReductionTensor l E X n (((T.obj P).obj Q).X (i + j)) U s
            (totalPair.{u, u} X R P Q i j U x y)) ∧
      ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E X) ℤ) (n : ℕ),
        (T.obj P).map
            ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (sfReductionTransition l E X n) (.up ℤ)).app Q) ≫
            b P Q n =
          b P Q (n + 1) ≫
            (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (sfReductionTransition l E X n) (.up ℤ)).app
              ((T.obj P).obj Q)
